messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~1932001098. Paging @Leah - oncall. Please acknowledge and run triage.
Leah - oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Checking router metrics + recent deploys.
Matt - sres: I can join. Any obvious deploys? deploy-bot: deploy event: service=runtime tag=release-2026-03-15T09:12 sha=abc123 triggered by ci-pipeline at 1932000700
Leah - oncall: Noted. Rolling window shows error rate spike at 1932001080 -> 5m ago. 5xxs mainly 502/504, a few 500s.
Jamal - eng-runtime: Pulling runtime logs for the period. Heads up: we recently changed sampling on the runtime logger to 10% for info traces — may miss full request body logs.
Leah - oncall: That's problematic for root cause. Can you pull any raw nginx/gateway logs? If sampling omitted requests we need wire-level traces.
Matt - sres: I'm running ad-hoc query: `sum(rate(http_response_status{job=\"gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m])) by (status)` -> spike aligned with 1932001080. Also seeing increased upstream timeouts.
Sophia - customer-success: Are customers impacted? CS flag: a handful of high-value accounts reported timeouts just now. Ticket #CS-1423 opened.
Jamal - eng-runtime: I can fetch full upstream logs from the gateway cluster but need to bump log export retention. I requested a temporary export to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1932001111.
Leah - oncall: Good. While that runs, can someone check if the canary route got weighted incorrectly? Our routing policy can fallback to a heavier model that times out.
Matt - sres: Checking routing rules. Canary weight unchanged. However, autoscaler for runtime-pool-4 shows several pods in CrashLoopBackOff around 1932001050-1932001100 — maybe overload/backpressure.
Jamal - eng-runtime: CrashLoopBackOff due to OOM in the new kernel path; stack shows KV cache eviction spikes. We're seeing GC thrash at ~1932001045.
Leah - oncall: Hypothesis A: recent runtime release interacts poorly with long-sequence requests causing KV cache growth -> OOMs -> 502s. Hypothesis B: upstream gateway sampling hid request payloads, delaying detection of malformed batched requests.
Sophia - customer-success: Mitigation needed for customers now. Can we fallback traffic to a stable model or capacity?
Leah - oncall: Initiating mitigation: routing rule to divert 30% traffic to stable model v1.2 and spin up extra nodes in dedicated pool as emergency capacity. Matt, can you trigger a manual scale?
Matt - sres: Scaling runtime-pool-4 +3 nodes now. Also applying temporary NGINX timeout increase to 60s to reduce 504s while we stabilize.
Jamal - eng-runtime: Rolling back the offending kernel patch would be safest but rollback will take ~15-20m. I can start it if we want full rollback.
Leah - oncall: Do it. Start rollback now. Marking action: `rollback release-2026-03-15T09:12` by Jamal.
deploy-bot: rollback started: release-2026-03-15T09:12 by Jamal (1932001220). Estimated time: 12m
Matt - sres: Scale completed +3 nodes at 1932001255. NGINX timeout applied. Error rate dropping from peak but still above baseline.
Sophia - customer-success: Notifying affected accounts with an advisory: short timeouts causing failed requests; mitigation in progress.
Leah - oncall: Log export complete to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1932001111. Downloading subset for timeline building and sharing with eng.
Jamal - eng-runtime: I extracted a handful of raw request payloads — one pattern: repeated long prefix prompts with token counts >8192 coinciding with high KV cache churn. Attaching excerpt in thread (redacted).
Leah - oncall: Good find. Adding to timeline: 1932001045 - increased long-seq requests; 1932001050 - GC thrash; 1932001080 - 5xx spike; 1932001220 - rollback initiated; 1932001300 - rollback complete; 1932001350 - error rate returned to baseline.
Matt - sres: After rollback finished at 1932001300, error rate normalized by ~1932001350. Confirming customer impact window ~1932001080-1932001350 (~45m).
Sophia - customer-success: I'm drafting a postmortem update for customers: short outage/latency spike due to runtime release interactions with long-sequence workloads; mitigations: rollback + scale + routing rollback.
Leah - oncall: Observability notes: sampling config change hid full request bodies during critical window. Action item: revert sampling change and ensure full debug logs are enabled for 30m around deploys or incidents.
Jamal - eng-runtime: Agreed. Also need dashboards to surface KV cache size and eviction rate; they were missing on the incident overview. Filing infra ticket INF-392.
Matt - sres: Recorded remediation: add pre-deploy smoke checks that include long-sequence synthetic requests to detect KV growth, add alert for pod OOM rate, and require no sampling changes in runtime logger without approval.
Leah - oncall: Oncall handoff to Matt in 1h. I'll tidy timeline and drop into incident tracker. Good job all. :thumbsup:
